_comment: Template for future codemap-arm runs. ${CODEMAP_REPO} is expanded to the repo root at runtime (bench writes a resolved copy under bench/results/); claude runs with cwd=fixture, so paths must be absolute. CODEMAP_DATA is isolated. CODEMAP_MCP_PROFILE=agent is pinned exactly to the 22 taught/discovery tools; historical committed runs used the compatible core inventory, and the pre-profile 2026-07-12 run used 39 schemas.
